components.name: Primary Analysis Button
components.description: Runs the real orchestration workflow and exposes loading state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 52px; padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--color-primary, oklch(0.52 0.145 145)); color: var(--color-bg, oklch(1 0 0)); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 700 14px/1.4 Avenir Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 100ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-dark, oklch(0.42 0.13 145)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary, oklch(0.52 0.145 145)); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Analysis Input
components.description: Visible-label field for markets and numeric constraints.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: oklch(0.19 0.025 145); font: 700 14px/1.4 Avenir Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.19 0.025 145); border: 1px solid oklch(0.74 0.025 145); border-radius: 6px; font: 400 16px/1.5 Avenir Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: oklch(0.49 0.018 145); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.52 0.145 145); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Policy Pass Chip
components.description: Text-first semantic status for candidates that pass active policy.
components.css: .ds-chip-pass { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 10px; background: oklch(0.94 0.045 145); color: oklch(0.42 0.13 145); border-radius: 999px; font: 700 12px/1.2 Avenir Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif; }

components.name: Candidate Evidence Row
components.description: Flat comparison row for one market and its decision metrics.
components.css: .ds-candidate { padding: 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.012 145); color: oklch(0.19 0.025 145); font: 400 16px/1.5 Avenir Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-candidate > div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-candidate dl { display: flex; gap: 24px; margin: 16px 0 0; } .ds-candidate dt { color: oklch(0.49 0.018 145); font-size: 12px; } .ds-candidate dd { margin: 4px 0 0; font: 700 14px/1.5 SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; }

narrative.overview: LiquidFlux is a composed analyst's workspace in clear daylight. Evidence is easy to compare, workflow stages remain visible, and every decision can be traced to current market data. Confidence comes from hierarchy, provenance, and restraint rather than decorative spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained semantic color on a true white workspace
Fixed product typography with selective monospaced data
Flat analytical surfaces with state-driven motion
Responsive structure without hiding core evidence

rules.name: The Ten Percent Rule
rules.body: Research Green is rare enough to retain meaning. It never floods the dashboard or becomes decorative glow.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red always pair with explicit text and shape. Color never carries state alone.

rules.name: The Numbers Earn Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospaced type is reserved for values that benefit from alignment and auditability. It is never a blanket crypto aesthetic.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Analytical surfaces remain on one plane. Candidates are divided comparison rows, not an identical grid of floating cards.

dos: Do make the objective, constraints, and current workflow state understandable within two seconds.
Do expose provenance, freshness, conflicts, rejection reasons, and the approval boundary beside the decision they qualify.
Do use sentence-case labels and tabular numerals for comparable evidence.
Do preserve 44px touch targets, visible focus, reduced motion, and local table scrolling.
donts: Don't imitate a Binance Futures trading screen with flashing prices, red/green overload, urgency, or gambling cues.
Don't use generic AI-dashboard styling such as decorative glow, excessive gradients, glass cards, or unexplained AI recommendations.
Don't build a lifeless enterprise admin panel with dense navigation, undifferentiated gray tables, and weak visual hierarchy.
Don't use colored side stripes, gradient text, decorative grid backgrounds, nested cards, or identical card grids.
